script: Never text, "What's up?" Send her this theory instead. A boring answer kills the conversation, so send exactly this: "I have a theory about you." "I'm not telling you yet." She'll answer right away, because nobody can ignore a theory about themselves. She'll ask, "What theory?" And here's the move. You say: "I'll tell you when you prove me right." And then disappear. Don't explain. Don't add anything. Now she's replaying every conversation, trying to work out what you noticed. The more she thinks about the theory, the more she thinks about you. Most men give answers. You give a question. Comment the word THEORY, and I'll send you the exact messages.
